[b]A Mystery of the sand[/b]
[i]After the upsurge of Islamic violence in New Westmore, the Hydronian government Immediately became suspicious. Cobra Team, the top-tier special forces of Hydronia have been given authorisation to begin aerial searches over the deserts of Argos, looking for possible encampments belonging to the so-called "Al-Qadi"[/i]

"This is our third flyover Elvan, I'm pretty sure you didn't see anything,"
"Yes I did, just wait,"
"Fine..."
"THERE!"
"Where?"
"Right down there, pilot take us closer,"
The helicopter begins to descend,
"B*k! I see it, we gotta land, they could have AA systems!"
The helicopter starts descending quicker now, until it lands in the sand around 1km away from the camp they spotted. A team of 20 armed troops disembark and lie low in the sand, behind a small hill. Various soldiers pull out binoculars and start searching the camp from afar.
"hmmm... I don't see anything other than camels here,"
"Wait, what's that! I see people, but they aren't Al-Qadi, or at least they don't seem like it,"
In the camp, there appears a group of tribal people. Suddenly one of them turns and looks the soldier straight in the eye.
"B*k, they definitely saw us there sir,"
"They seem peaceful enough, perhaps we make contact"
"Shut up! They're looking at us really suspiciously now..."
The tribal people continue to stare at the soldier with confusion...

[i]Então digam-me, ó sábios Koolemany... [/i]
Foi oque Wurtalpaperguntou, seus olhos castanhos reluziam com o sol os tornando mais claros, sua pele marcada pelo sol era bloqueada por camadas e camadas de tecido de suas roupas grossas, aquele era um dos assentamentos dos Koolemany, e eles estavam em uma Gunya típica, o pequeno abrigo tinha ali além do próprio Wurtalpa, Ngayhl o líder do clã coala e outros 4 do clã.
[i]Oque preveem para este Widjuru(estação seca)? [/i]
Ngayhl, seu corpo frágil e velho, agarrou a folha de eucalipto, o totem de seu clã, e então fechou seus olhos, por um momento, e então os outros do clã fecharam os olhos juntos e entraram em tjurrupa, alguns minutos depois, eles abriram olhos e então o mais velho pôs a mão na cabeça de Wurtalpa, que logo entrou em transe acessando ao plano profundo...
[i]Eu vi uma névoa esverdeada saindo dos céus e alcançando soakages, então vi uma figura sombria de olhos vermelhos olhando para mim, ele usava uma tiara de diamantes e jóias.[/i]
O clã coala se chocou com a visão, Ngayhl então logo apertou com força a folha em suas mãos e disse.
[b]Algo sombrio se aproxima de nosso povo.[/b]
Foi oque o velho disse, logo Wurtalpa saiu do pequeno abrigo, subiu em um camelo e partiu para o assentamento principal novamente.

[i]So tell me, oh wise Koolemany... [/i]
That's what Wurtalpa asked, his brown eyes shone with the sun making them clearer, his sun-marked skin was blocked by layers and layers of fabric from his thick clothes, that was one of the Koolemany settlements, and they were in a typical Gunya, the small shelter had there besides Wurtalpa himself, Ngayhl the leader of the koala clan and 4 others from the clan.
[i]What do you foresee for this Widjuru (dry season)? [/i]
Ngayhl, his frail and old body, grabbed the eucalyptus leaf, his clan's totem, and then closed his eyes for a moment, and then the others of the clan closed their eyes together and entered tjurrupa, a few minutes later, they opened their eyes and then the eldest placed his hand on Wurtalpa's head, who soon entered a trance accessing the deep plane...
[i]I saw a greenish mist coming out of the skies and reaching soakages, then I saw a shadowy figure with red eyes looking at me, he wore a tiara of diamonds and jewels.[/i]
The koala clan was shocked by the sight, Ngayhl then quickly squeezed the leaf tightly in his hands and said.
[b]Something dark is approaching our people.[/b]
That's what the old man said, soon Wurtalpa left the small shelter, got on a camel and set off for the main settlement again.

[i]Oque vocês fazem aqui.[/i]
Um homem perguntou, parecendo que emergiu da areia montado em um camelo, ele usava várias camadas de tecido para se proteger dos raios solares quentes, além de um cajado de madeira atrás em suas costas, seus olhos pareciam esconder um medo e terror, de algo incerto, mas era claro, ele tentou esconder isso com uma confusão, e então perguntou.
[i]Vocês não parecem de Nordiheim, quem são, de onde vieram, e o mais importante, oque os trás até aqui, permitam-me de se apresentar primeiro de tudo, eu sou Wurtalpa do clã Kipara, um dos membros do clã que governa nosso povo. [/i]
[i]What are you doing here?[/i]
A man asked, looking like he had emerged from the sand riding a camel, he was wearing several layers of fabric to protect himself from the hot sun rays, in addition to a wooden staff behind his back, his eyes seemed to hide fear and terror, of something uncertain, but it was clear, he tried to hide it with confusion, and then asked.
[i]You don't look like you're from Nordiheim, who are you, where did you come from, and most importantly, what brings you here, allow me to introduce myself first of all, I am Wurtalpa of the Kipara clan, one of the members of the clan that governs our people.[/i]
